And therefore the Torah was strict regarding basar b'chalav only concerning the meat of cattle specifically — in which is the essential hold of the spirit of folly — the aspect of Esav — only that Israel rectify it through shechitah — etc. — as stated. And therefore it requires shechitah of both signs — and its blood does not require covering — and its fat is forbidden — as stated. But the meat of a chayah — in which the light of holy life-force shines more — therefore its fat is permitted — and its blood requires covering. And all the more so fowl — which requires only one sign — therefore there is no biblical prohibition of basar b'chalav with it. But even so it is also rabbinically forbidden.

[§3]
And therefore holy Torah expressed this prohibition in the language: "you shall not cook a kid in its mother's milk" — even though gedi [kid] includes all cattle. And this is because in the kid there is an extra hold for the aspect of Esav the hairy man. And therefore it is said of Yaakov: "and the skins of the kids of the goats she placed on his hands" — etc. — and it is said afterwards: "and he did not recognize him for his hands were like the hands of Esav his brother — hairy." And see in the holy Zohar what is explained regarding the kids of the goats — and why even so they are permitted for Israel's eating. And therefore the Torah alluded: since in the meat of cattle — the aspect of gedi — there is an extra hold for the aspect of Esav — but Israel rectify it through the mitzvos of shechitah and nikur [removal of forbidden fat and sinews] and salting — therefore: if one cooks it in cattle milk — which was drawn and clarified from its blood — in the aspect of the blood becoming congealed and becoming milk — and it became so clarified of itself through the supernal power coming upon it from above — whose root is from the aspect of supernal whiteness — the aspect of wisdom and thought — through which all holy clarifications — in the aspect of: kulhu b'machshavah isbariru [all are clarified through thought] — and from there the redness of the blood — in which the sitra achra of Esav the red one has seized — was sweetened until it was turned into whiteness — the whiteness of milk — until it became permitted for Israel's eating without any rectification at all. And this is the aspect of: *"and enough milk of goats for your bread — etc. — and life for your maidens"* [Mishlei 27:27] — for it is from the aspect of wisdom and life — as stated.

[§4]
Therefore: if one cooks in it meat of cattle — in which the sitra achra of Esav has greatly seized — through this one gives it room to overpower even more — G-d forbid. And therefore the Torah was strict specifically in the manner of cooking — for through cooking the flavors of one and the other blend together even more — until they are completely included together and become one — and through this it has the power to suckle and overpower even more. And therefore the cooking itself is also forbidden. And its prohibition is so severe — to the point that it is also forbidden for any benefit — for even the benefit alone that the person receives from it greatly damages his soul — for through this the aspect of Esav — who is forbidden for all benefit — seizes upon him. For all the good of the wicked is evil for the righteous — as understood also regarding Yaakov our father when Esav said to him: "let me place" — etc. And therefore it only applies to the meat of a pure animal in pure milk — where both are permitted. And even meat of neveilah or forbidden fat — even so — at minimum they are of a permitted species.

[§5]
But if the meat or milk is of an impure species — then there is no prohibition of basar b'chalav regarding cooking and benefit — since it is forbidden anyway from the beginning of its creation — the sitra achra no longer has room to suckle from holiness through this. And therefore: fish and locusts — which require no shechitah at all — are permitted with milk — even rabbinically. But even so — biblically it is only forbidden through the manner of cooking — and specifically meat of cattle in cattle milk.

[§6]
Even so: our Sages forbade even placing cheese on the table together with meat — even meat of a chayah or fowl — since one may come to eat them together — and give the sitra achra a hold to seize. And not only that — but even if one has already eaten meat — one must not eat cheese afterwards — etc. — as explained in the Shulchan Aruch. For since the sitra achra has some hold in it — one must be concerned also regarding what one eats afterwards — since it draws its flavor even more — or there may remain some between the teeth. But if one ate the cheese first — one need not be concerned about what one eats meat afterwards — provided through rinsing and washing — and see in the Shulchan Aruch. And therefore: basar b'chalav does not apply biblically with the milk of a slaughtered or dead animal. For our Sages taught [Bechoros 6b] — regarding the permission of milk — it is an innovation [chiddush] — since it resembles a limb from a living animal yet the Torah permitted it. And therefore one may say: specifically with milk from a living animal — whose permission itself is an innovation — therefore if one cooks meat in it — the sitra achra is aroused to suckle from this — as stated. But not so with the milk of a slaughtered animal — whose permission is not such an innovation. And likewise with milk of a dead animal — which has departed from the prohibition of a limb from a living animal — and even though it is now forbidden because of neveilah — it is in truth forbidden — and the sitra achra has no room to suckle from this. And even according to those who hold that milk of neveilah has no biblical prohibition of neveilah — one may say they hold: even so the prohibition of a limb from a living animal has departed from it — and therefore it is not such an innovation — since it is milk of a dead animal. (And see this matter in the legal authorities.) But even so: even with the milk of a slaughtered animal — it is rabbinically forbidden. And see Siman 30 regarding the law of kechal [udder].

segments.he: וזה שארז"ל כיצד ביעור חמץ פוררו וזורה לרוח או זורקו לים או שורפו, ומובא ששלש בחינות אלו שהם בחי' השלש יסודות ראשונות שהם אש רוח מים ששרשם שלש אותיות ראשונו' שבשם הוי"ה ב"ה ועל ידיהם מכניעים ומבערים כל הסט"א שהם בחי' חמץ ונותנין כח לבחי' המלכות דקדושה שהיא בחי' הה"א אחרונה שהיא בחי' מצה, היינו כנ"ל. והשלש אותיות הקדושים הם בחי' הט"ל אורות (כמובא במאמר אני ה' סימן י"א) וכולם כלולים בהתורה הקדושה, כי אורייתא שמא דקוב"ה וכו'. וזה בחי' כי טל אורות טלך ודרז"ל מי שיש בו טל תורה טל דייקא היינו כנ"ל. וע"י התורה הקדושה מכניעין כח היצה"ר ומבערין בחי' המלכות דסט"א בחי' מלכות עשו כשדרז"ל על פסוק "הקול קול יעקב וכו'", וזה הקול קול יעקב, כי הקול כלול מאש מים רוח כידוע, אך עיקר מצות ביעור חמץ הוא באש כי מהאש יצאו והאש תאכלם כי מאחר שעיקר כחם הוא ע"י היצה"ר שהוא בחי' אש בחי' נורא ביה עמרם שזה בחינת ויצא הראשון אדמוני דייקא ע"כ צריכין לבערו באש שהוא ג"כ בחי' התורה בחי' הלא כה דברי כאש היינו ללמוד תורה בכח וחמימות והתלהבות דקדושה ועי"ז נותנין כח לבחי' המלכות דקדושה שהיא ג"כ בחי' אש אוכלה עד שזוכין על ידי זה לקבל מאור השכל העליון שהוא ג"כ בחי' אש כנ"ל (וזה ג"כ מה שהפסח אינו נאכל אלא צלי אש דייקא וכן והנותר ממנו באש תשרופו וכו' בכדי שלא יהיה ממנו איזה יניקה להם ח"ו)
segments.en: [§12] But to actually remove the ruach ra'ah — which is the ruach shtus [spirit of foolishness] of the yetzer hara — this is achieved only through mayim [water], which is the aspect of engaging in Torah study. For the entire Torah is the holy Names of G-d, may He be blessed — and therefore it possesses the power, as a segula, to banish every manner of ruach ra'ah and ruach shtus — as is explained within [the discourse].

segments.he: סימן תנ"א וכו'

וזה בחי' דיני הגעלה. והכלל כי כתשמישו כך הכשרו, כי אפילו מי שנכשל כבר ח"ו בעצת יצרו הרע ח"ו ופגם בבחי' המלכות וכן בבחי' השכל הנ"ל אעפ"כ גם לו יש תקנה כי אין לך דבר שעומד בפני התשובה אך צריך ליזהר שתהא התשובה כפי החטא והפגם:
segments.en:
סִימָן צ״א וְכוּ׳

[§1]
Meat and cheese that touched each other are permitted — but one must wash — etc. — for since they touched only while cold — one need only be concerned about what adhered visibly — and washing suffices. And likewise regarding the person: if something not good — G-d forbid — merely touched his heart and thought — if it was only incidentally — and he did not deepen it in the warmth of the inclination — but only in a cold manner — it suffices for him to wash — to purify his heart with the pure waters of Torah and holy intellect. But initially one certainly must guard oneself even from such an aspect — lest one eat it without washing — perhaps one will not immediately place one's heart to wash and purify one's heart from all the dross that adheres to it even while cold — and one's service will be found mixed with dross — G-d forbid.

[§2]
And all of this is while cold. But while hot — even if only the milk is hot — and cold meat fell into it — etc. — everything is forbidden — for tata'ah gabar [the lower one prevails] — for the lower one heats the upper — or cools it — according to what the lower is — whether hot or cold. For everything depends on the lower ones — for b'itarusa d'letata isitar le'eilah [through arousal from below comes arousal from above]. And likewise regarding our matter: wisdom and intellect is the aspect of the higher level — the aspect of head and firstness — and it is written: "the path of life is upward for the wise" [Mishlei 15:24] — etc. And Malchus is the aspect of the lower level — for it is the aspect of sof davar. And therefore it is said of it: "this is Jerusalem — which I have placed in the midst of the nations" [Yechezkel 5:5] — etc. — and therefore there is the essential battle — as understood also within. And therefore everything depends according to the aspect of the lower: if it is hot — meaning: the fierce boiling of judgments has prevailed in it — then even if the lower is permitted and into it fell forbidden that is cold — everything becomes forbidden. And if the lower is cold — even if it is forbidden — and into it fell permitted that is hot — and it forbids if the impure is salted. For salt alludes to the aspect of intellect — as explained above in Orach Chaim — and therefore: if the impure is salted and dresses itself in some aspect of intellect — therefore even the permitted is also forbidden.

[§3]
And see in the Shulchan Aruch the particulars therein. And this is the aspect of nullification of the prohibition in sixty. For all mixture of a prohibition in something permitted is the aspect of damage to holy Malchus — the aspect of nun. And our Sages taught: why is the letter nun not written in Ashrei — because it contains a falling — etc. — and even so David returned and supported it through the holy spirit — as it is said: "Hashem supports all the fallen" [Tehillim 145:14]. And therefore: if there are sixty times the amount of permitted — this alludes to the strengthening and support that holiness has — through the aspect of the samech [60] — the aspect of: "sixty are the queens" [Shir HaShirim 6:8]. And see in the discourse Heichal HaKodesh, Siman 59.

[§4]
And therefore: we do not say chaticha na'asis neveilah [the piece becomes like a carcass] except regarding basar b'chalav — which is the body of the prohibition itself — and is from the aspect of the sitra achra — the aspect of neveilah — the opposite of the holy moon. But if the piece absorbed from other prohibitions — we do not say chaticha na'asis neveilah biblically — by all opinions. For since the body of the piece is permitted — it is from the side of holiness — only that it became mixed with the prohibition — and therefore it is now in the aspect of falling and becomes forbidden. But even so: it still has hope to rise from its fall — through the aspect of the samech — meaning: when permitted is added upon it until the prohibition becomes nullified in sixty — the aspect of: "Hashem supports all the fallen." And therefore one does not nullify a prohibition initially — only when permitted is added automatically without the intention to nullify. For this is the aspect of what our Sages taught: "it has fallen and shall not rise again by itself" — but rather the Holy One, blessed be He, Himself will raise it — as it were — the aspect of: "I will raise up the fallen Tabernacle of David" [Amos 9:11]. And likewise regarding this: when one intends to add permitted to nullify the prohibition — it is as if — as it were — the aspect of holiness — the aspect of Knesses Yisrael — rises by itself to nullify the prohibition. But when it is added automatically — this is heavenly assistance — the providence of Hashem — the aspect of: "Hashem supports" — (Himself as it were) — "all the fallen" — to raise them — the aspect of "I will raise up the fallen Tabernacle of David" — as stated. Even though the essential fullness is specifically through arousal from below — as is known — meaning: through our arousal from below — Hashem Himself is aroused — as it were — to raise us. (And there is no room to elaborate further here.)

segments.he: וע"כ כלי שנשתמש בצונן ורק לפי שעה כי לא עמד בו החמץ מעת לעת ע"כ מדיחו בצונן ודיו, וכמו כן לענינינו מאחר שעיקר הפגם הוא על ידי כח האש דסטרא אחרא כנ"ל ע"כ אם לא נשתמש רק בצונן היינו שלא היה הפגם בחשק וחמימות היצר ח"ו רק בבחי' שגיאות מי יבין ובבחי' והאלהים אנה לידו שנזדמן לו איזה פגם בשוגג ובלי מתכוין ושום חשק דסט"א כלל וגם לא שהה מעת לעת רק הוא ממארי דחושבנא ובקרוב התבונן וראה שנזדמן לו איזה פגם שלא במתכוין ושב והתחרט ע"ז מאד אזי די לו ג"כ בשטיפת צונן, היינו לרחוץ ולטהר עצמו ולבבו מבחוץ ומבפנים במים טהורים של תורה ותשובה ולקבל על עצמו ליזהר בנפשו ביותר מכאן ואילך ודי לו, וכן יש לומר ע"ד שארז"ל (יומא דף פ"ו) עבר על עשה ושב אינו זז משם עד שמוחלין לו וזה ג"כ בחי' נשתמש בצונן שהיה לו צנינות וקרירות בענין עשיית המצוה אבל התבונן מיד ושב מוחלין לו.
segments.en: Just as the Name Havayah [הויה] and the Name Adnus [אדנות] are the root of the aspects of sun and moon, as is known — so too in this [matter of blessings]: in one's thought, which is the aspect of Abba, the aspect of Chochmah [mocha — the brain], one should have in mind the Name Havayah as it is written. And in one's speech, through the mouth, which is the aspect of Malchus [sovereignty], one reads it as Adnus. For since the light of the holy intellect is very great, it is impossible to receive from it except through the aspect of Malchus — as is explained within [the discourse].

segments.he: אבל אם נשתמש בו ברותחין, היינו שהיו הפגמים ע"י רתיחות היצה"ר אזי אם נשתמש ע"י האור בעצמו בלי מים אזי צריך ליבון באש דייקא, היינו אם נתפתה ליצרו לעשות איזה עוון במזיד ח"ו אזי חוץ מפגם העון בעצמו יש עוד פגם גדול ביותר שפרק ממנו עול מלכות שמים ונתן כח לבחי' המלכות דסט"א שהיא בחי' ע"ז ח"ו ע"כ צריך שתהיה תשובתו ג"כ בחמימות והתלהבות דקדושה כ"כ עד שתהי' בבחי' ליבון באש ממש היינו בבחינת מסירות נפש ממש או ע"י הצדיק והת"ח האמת שהוא בחי' אש והוא שורש המלכות כמבואר במאמר אנכי סי' ד'.
segments.en:
סִימָן צ״ח וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת תַּעֲרֻבוֹת

[§1]
The laws of mixtures. And therefore specifically in a different species — where the taste of the prohibition is recognizable and perceived — sixty is needed to nullify it. For then presumably the taste of the prohibition is already nullified and no longer perceived. And therefore: anything whose taste matters — even in a thousand it is not nullified — since the taste of the prohibition is still perceived. And the matter of taste in every thing — it flows at its root from the aspect of intellect and daas — as cited above in Orach Chaim. And therefore: as long as the taste of the prohibition — which is from the aspect of the sitra achra — is still perceived — it is forbidden. But if the prohibition is from the Torah — through the majority — since the majority is from the side of holiness — therefore the prohibition is nullified through the majority — for biblically we follow the majority. And therefore a person is judged according to his majority — and so the world — as our Sages taught. But even so rabbinically — sixty is needed even in the same species in liquid with liquid.

[§2]
And therefore: prohibited matters also combine to nullify one another — if they are different in taste — as explained in Siman 98, paragraph 9. To indicate: the sitra achra is not an independent authority — G-d forbid — but they too receive life-force from Him — as elaborated in his teachings in many places. And therefore: when Hashem wants to subdue the sitra achra — sometimes He subdues it from itself — mineih uveih ava lizol beih narga [from it and by it the axe goes into it] — as we find: the fall of Vashti through Haman — and the completion of Haman's fall through Charvonah. And similarly many more. And this touches somewhat also on what our Sages taught: "great is a transgression performed for its own sake" — etc. — for even though the transgression itself is certainly from the aspect of the sitra achra — even so: when one's intention is truly for the sake of Heaven — sometimes the sitra achra is subdued through this specifically. But because of the great danger — one must certainly be extremely careful about such a thing. And likewise: sometimes one must use the quality of anger and cruelty to take vengeance against the wicked — and many more similar things. And it is self-evident in general from this: when Hashem wants to strengthen the power of holiness — He sometimes brings it support and reinforcement from the other side — in the aspect of: "and the evil angel is forced to say amen." And this is the aspect of what Haman's wise men and Zeresh his wife themselves told him: "if he is of the seed of the Jews — etc. — you shall surely fall before him." And likewise: Achashveirosh himself commanded that Haman be killed — and removed his ring from his hand — and gave it to Mordechai.

segments.he: והנה טבע האש אינו להפליט הבליעה מהכלי רק שורפו בתוכו ונעשה לעפר, וע"כ מחמת שנשרש כח הסט"א בלבו על ידי כח האש בעצמו על כן צריך ליבון באש ובזה מתקן מה שפגם בבחי' האש והעפר דקדושה שהם כנגד בחי' השכל ובחי' מלכות הנ"ל, אבל מה שנשתמש ברותחין שנתערב בהם כח האש והמים שזה בחי' מה שלפעמים היצה"ר מתלבש עצמו במצות ובאמת ידע אינש בנפשיה כי הוא בעצמו החייב בדבר כי אלו היה משים אל לבו להתבונן היטב בדבר לאמתו לשם שמים בלבד לא היה יכול היצה"ר להטעותו ולסמות עיניו כ"כ עד שיהפוך לו עבירה למצוה ח"ו רק מסתמא היה לו איזה נגיעה בדבר לגרמיה ולהנאתו ג"כ, ועוד יש בחי' רבות כאלה שמעורב בהם חמימות היצר וגם איזה כונה ומחשבה לטובה ג"כ ואעפ"כ הוא פגם ועון ובא רק מצד היצה"ר והסט"א, אלא שזה בחי' החמץ הבלוע בכלי על ידי שנשתמש ברותחין ע"כ צריך הגעלה ברותחין, היינו שיעסוק בתורה שכלולה ג"כ מאש ומים כידוע ויעסקו בה בכח וחמימות דקדושה ועי"ז יפליט מקרבו כח הרע של הסט"א והיצה"ר שנשאר בו ויזכה להתגבר עליו וליתן כח למלכות דקדושה כנ"ל, ולתקן הפגמים בעצמם מבואר כבר בספרי קדושים התיקון לכל פגם ועון ר"ל.
segments.en: [§1] And this is the aspect of the blessing of Asher Yatzar — "Who formed man with wisdom" [O.C. 6] — that is, that He created him with a wondrous wisdom, to the degree that there is within him the capacity to perceive the intellect and wisdom that exists in every thing — in order to draw close to Hashem, may He be blessed, through that very thing. And this: "and created within him openings and hollows" — etc.

segments.he: ובזה יש ג"כ חילוקי דינים בענין אם נבלע ברותחין שעומדין אצל האור או שכבר הוסר מהאש, וכן בין כלי ראשון לכלי שני וכן בדין עירוי מכלי ראשון, וכן בענין אם הולכין אחר רוב תשמישו, וכן אם נבלע בצונן על ידי כבוש מעת לעת או דבר חריף, ודיני כלי חרס וכיוצא, וכן בדיני הגעלה קודם זמן איסור חמץ או לאחר זמן איסורו והכל סובב והולך על דרך זה כמובא בספרי קודש וכמובן גם בזוה"ק, וע"כ אפילו במקום שצריך רק ליבון קל בעינן עכ"פ שיהיה הקש נשרף עליו מבחוץ היינו להמשיך בחי' והיה בית יעקב אש וכו' ובית עשו לקש ודלקו בהם ואכלום וכו':
segments.en: סִימָן ק׳ וְכוּ׳

segments.he: סימן תנ"ג וכו'

גלות מצרים נשתלשל מחטא אדם הראשון שפגם בבחי' התיקונים הנ"ל ע"י אכילת עה"ד וכו'. כידוע ואח"כ נסתבב הדבר ע"י שאמר אברהם אבינו במה אדע כי אירשנה ובזה פגם בבחי' ירושת א"י שהיא כלולה מכל התיקונים הנ"ל ואז נאמר לו ידוע תדע כי גר יהיה זרעך וכו'.
segments.en:
[§1]
And therefore: a beryah [whole creature] is not nullified — etc. — and it has the law of beryah only if it had life-force in it and was forbidden from the beginning of its creation. For since it was forbidden from the beginning of its creation — and never had a permitted moment — and it had life-force — from this it is self-evident that both it and its life-force are from the aspect of the sitra achra. And therefore — because of its power and importance — our Sages taught: it cannot be reversed to become permitted and move to the side of holiness — and even in a thousand it is not nullified. For every time one encounters the prohibition and eats it — one damages one's soul through it — since it was rooted in the aspect of the life-force of the sitra achra — which is the essential sitra d'mosa — the aspect of: "in their lives they are called dead" — as is known.

segments.he: ואח"כ פגמו השבטים במה שמכרו את יוסף למצרים, וע"י כל זה קבלה המלכות דסט"א כח ביותר לשעבד את ישראל, רק אח"כ נתהפך הכל לטובה בבחי' עת אשר שלט האדם באדם לרע לו כי דייקא ע"י שנמכר יוסף למצרים הכניע ושיבר שם כח הסט"א ביותר ע"י שעמד שם בניסיונו וקשר א"ע על השכל דק' בבחי' דמותו של אביו יעקב ראה וכו' כמבואר במ"א ושיבר שם כח היצה"ר והסט"א עד שזכה שפרעה בעצמו שם אותו למושל בכל ארץ מצרים ועי"ז היה קיום אח"כ לישראל בגלות מצרים כשארז"ל רק אעפ"כ לע"ע עי"ז נסתבב שירדו יעקב ובניו דייקא שהם היו יחידי הדור שזכו לקבל עליהם עול מלכות שמים שלימה ולקשר עצמם אל השכל דקדושה בשלימות שרק בשביל זה היתה כל הבריאה בגין דישתמודעין ליה כנ"ל, וע"כ באמת כשירדו למצרים ירדה גם השכינה עמהם כמו שארז"ל וכמו שהבטיח לו השי"ת אנכי ארד עמך מצרימה ואנכי אעלך וכו', וזה שסיפרה התורה הק' ואלה שמות וכו' וימת יוסף וכל אחיו וכו' ובני ישראל פרו וישרצו וכו' ותמלא הארץ אותם ובזה נתגדל ונתרחב שם דייקא כח המלכות דקדושה בבחי' ברוב עם הדרת מלך ואז נתעורר זה לעומת זה בחי' המלכות דסט"א לחשוב מחשבות ע"ז, וזה ויקם מלך חדש וכו' ויאמר אל עמו וכו' הבה נתחכמה וכו', נתחכמה דייקא להגביר בחי' החכמה והשכל דסט"א נגד השכל דקדושה שהוא בחי' משה וזה לו ודרז"ל למושיען של ישראל וכו', וזה וישימו עליו שרי מסים וכו' שהגבירו עליהם שיעבוד המלכות דסט"א וכאשר יענו אותו כן ירבה וכן יפרוץ מחמת שהיו מקושרים מאד בפנימיות לבבם אל הקדושה ע"כ כל מה שהתגבר עליהם המלכות דסט"א בשיעבוד הגשמי כמו כן התגבר כח המלכות דקדושה ברוחניות להרבות זרעם, ולעומת זה התגבר עליהם שיעבוד מלכות דסט"א בכל פעם ביותר.
segments.en:
[§2]
And likewise: a piece that is worthy of being honored — since it is in the aspect of importance and honor — the aspect of Malchus and grace of the sitra achra — therefore it too is not nullified. And likewise: something that has a way to become permitted is not nullified in the same species. For until one eats it in the state of prohibition — one could eat it in the permitted state. And therefore: if one eats it in the time of its prohibition — even through nullification — one appears as if one has will and inclination toward the side of prohibition — since this very thing could be eaten in the permitted state.

segments.he: וזה ויעבידו מצרים את בני ישראל בפרך ודרז"ל בתחלה בפה רך וכו' כדרך הסט"א והיצר הרע שבתחילה מסית את האדם ומפתהו בחלקלקות לשונו כאלו מתכוין לטובתו ולפעמים מטעהו על ידי שמתלבש עצמו במצות ואח"כ הוא מושל עליו ועובד עמו בפרך ובקושי ונדמה להאדם שכבר הוא מוכרח לילך אחריו כשה לטבח יובל ר"ל ואח"כ גזר להמית את הזכרים שהם כנגד בחי' השכל דקדושה ולהחיות את הנקבות שהם מבחי' מלכות דקדושה בכדי לטמאות אותם ח"ו עי"ז יהיה להם יניקה ביותר מבחי' המלכות דקדושה.
segments.en: [§2] There are openings and hollows through which he draws and nurses his vitality — and the essence of vitality is through wisdom. And therefore, as is explained in the sacred kavanos, there are seven openings in the head — eye, ear, nostril, mouth — which are connected to the brain, as stated above. And there are openings and hollows through which food is digested and waste and excess are expelled outward — and this too is a repair of the brain and wisdom, as stated above.

segments.he: אבל ה' הפיר עצת גוים הניא מחשבות עמים ובתוך תוקף המרירות נולד משה רבינו ע"ה ותרא אותו כי טוב הוא ודרז"ל שנתמלא הבית כולו אורה כי פני משה כפני חמה והוא האיר עיני ישראל להסתכל רק בהשכל של כל דבר שזה עיקר האור כנ"ל, ותצפנהו וכו' ותקח לו תיבת גמא ותחמרה בחמר ובזפת וכו' ומבואר בזוה"ק תרין גוונין דאינון חיור ואוכם וכו', רומז לשני הבחינות הנ"ל כידוע, ואז ותרד בת פרעה לרחוץ וכו' והצילה את משה וכו' עד ומשה היה רועה וכו' וירא מלאך ה' אליו בלבת אש רומז לבחי' מלכות וזה מתוך הסנה כי כביכול בחי' מלכות היה בגלות ותמה משה על זה מאד מדוע לא יבער הסנה כי הלא אש אוכלה הוא ואז ויקרא אליו אלהים וכו' ויאמר אל תקרב הלום אין הלום אלא מלכות כי אסור לכנוס בקשיות כאלו כי זה סוד הבחירה שהיא תכלית כונת הבריאה ובעוה"ז א"א להשיג זאת כי אז תתבטל הבחירה וכמבואר מענין זה במקום אחר, ואז גילה לו כי כבר הגיע זמן הגאולה ומשה מיאן קצת בשליחותו כי ידע כי אין זה עדיין גאולה שלימה ועדיין תתגבר המלכות דסט"א כמה פעמים, כי לבעל בחירה קשה לעזור ולהועיל ובכל יום ויום יצרו של אדם מתגבר ומתחדש עליו, וע"כ התפלא ג"כ באיזה זכות יגאלו, כי אע"פ שהשי"ת בעצמו אמר לו ששמע צעקתם וריחם עליהם בזכות אבות, אעפ"כ התפלא ע"ז כי ידע גם ההיפך כי גדול כח הבחירה כמו שבאמת היה אח"כ מה שהיה, ובאמת השי"ת בעצמו בודאי ראה וידע את כל זה כמ"ש ראה ראיתי ודרז"ל שתי ראיות ואעפ"כ עלה ברצונו ית' לגאלם כי מאחר שיגאלו ויקבלו את התורה ובכח התורה הקדושה סוף כל סוף תתגבר המלכות דקדושה על הסט"א ויתתקן הכל.
segments.en:
סִימָן ק״ג וְכוּ׳

[§1]
And therefore: anything whose taste is spoiled does not forbid its mixture. For since one derives no benefit from the taste of the prohibition — but on the contrary — therefore it is not considered a taste at all and cannot forbid the permitted. And therefore: a vessel that is not a ben yomo [used within the last 24 hours] is considered a spoiled taste. For since the taste of the prohibition is not visible — only absorbed and covered and hidden within the vessel — and since a full cycle of day and night has passed over it — which encompasses the aspect of day and night — sun and moon — the taste of the prohibition has already become spoiled and weakened — and it no longer has the power to forbid the permitted. And therefore: if the permitted is a sharp thing — we say: it makes it desirable again. For through the power of sharpness — whose root is from the aspect of judgments — the aspect of what our Sages taught about the school of Shammai: that they were sharper — through this the power of the taste of the prohibition is aroused and strengthened — whose root is from the aspect of the extension of judgments. And some say: overnight weakens the prohibition — the aspect of bas dina batel dina [when the judgment has passed — the judgment is nullified]. And therefore our Sages taught: soaked is like cooked. For since it was soaked within the prohibition — or the prohibition within it — for a full cycle of day and night — even though it is cold — since the prohibition is visibly present and pressed into something liquid for a full cycle which encompasses the aspects of sun and moon — therefore through the power of the aspects of sun and moon of the sitra achra — the taste of the prohibition is absorbed within it — as through cooking. And the matter of tata'ah gabar and maliyach k'rosei'ach [salted is like boiled] is somewhat explained above.

segments.he: וזה שהודיע לו השי"ת אז בהוציאך וכו' תעבדון את האלהים על ההר הזה ופירש"י שתקבלו התורה עליו והוא הזכות העומדת לישראל כי עי"ז יהיה הכל על נכון כנ"ל, ואז ויאמר משה וכו' הנה אנכי בא וכו' ואמרת אליהם אלהי אבותיכם שלחני אליכם שזה בחי' אמונה בחי' מלכות שהיא נחלת אבות ואמרו לי מה שמו ומבואר בזוה"ק על פסוק אחר מה שמו דא חכמה היינו שירצו להשיג תיכף אור השכל והחכמה בעצמו, מה אומר אליהם ויאמר וכו' אהיה אשר אהיה, היינו שהודיע להם כי עצם השכל בעצמו א"א להשיג כי תכלית הידיעה אשר לא נדע וע"כ העיקר להחזיק עצמו תמיד באמת בבחי' מלכות דקדושה שהיא בחי' אמונה ועי"ז יזכה שיאיר לו איזה התנוצצות השכל ויזכה להשיג ביותר בחי' התכלית הנ"ל אשר לא נדע ויקבל על עצמו עוד בחי' עול מלכות שמיים שלימה באמונה זכה ובהירה ביותר ואז יזכה להשיג בחי' שכל עליון כמבואר במ"א.
segments.en: [§3] And this is what the blessing concludes: "and performs wonders" — for in this very thing one perceives the wonders of the Creator — how He connects the spiritual with the physical — to the degree that even in such physical matters as eating and drinking, whose waste is literally vomit and excrement, nonetheless wisdom and spirituality and divine life-force are clothed within them, upon which the vitality, healing, and continued existence of the human being depend — in the aspect of *"for not by bread alone does man live"* [Devarim 8:3]. And how much more so is there, in every thing in the world, divine life-force and holy intellect — through which a person can recognize Him, may He be blessed, and draw close to Him — and this is the primary intention of Creation, as the holy Zohar states: "in order that they may know Him."

segments.he: וזה בחי' אהיה אשר אהיה ויאמר כה תאמר אל בני ישראל אהיה שלחני אליכם, היינו שיודיע להם שתכלית ההשגה הקדושה הוא רק בבחי' אהיה דא אנא זמין למיהוי שיצפה בכ"פ להשיג השגה יתירה ביותר בכדי שיהיה לו שכל גבוה ועליון ביותר ואז יצפה שישיג עוד שכל עליון ביותר, וזה בעצמו בחי' היצה"ט בחי' המלכות דקדושה שנקרא מסכן וחכם כנ"ל, היינו כי בכל פעם רואה ומתבונן על עניותו, כי זה השכל שהשיג כבר אינו נחשב אצלו להשגה כלל כי הוא כבר במדריגה שאין זו השגה כלל רק עומד ומצפה שיקבל הארת החכמה עליונה ביותר ובאמת זהו עיקר שלימות החכמה וההשגה בחי' תכלית הידיעה אשר לא נדע וכנ"ל, וזהו ויאמר עוד ה' אל משה כה תאמר וכו' וסיים זה שמי לעלם וזה זכרי לדר דר, היינו השם הוי"ה ושם אדנ"י שהם שורש שני הבחינות הנ"ל.
segments.en:
סִימָן ק״ח

[§1]
And therefore: we say rei'ach [scent] is of no consequence after the fact — for the essential hold of the sitra achra and foolishness is only from the side of physicality and corporeality. But through scent — which is something spiritual — there is no power to forbid — unless one of them is a sharp thing — for then the prohibition has the power to overpower through the aspect of sharpness — as stated.

segments.he: וזה בחי' מה שאמר השי"ת למשה ונתתי את חן העם הזה בעיני מצרים וכו', היינו שתכנע המלכות דסט"א מלכות מצרים ותעלה המלכות דקדושה בחי' נו"ן ותתחבר עם החי"ת ויהיה עי"ז חן לישראל גם בעיני מצרים.
segments.en: [§4] And this is the aspect of the blessing of Elokai Neshamah — "My G-d, the soul which You placed within me — she is pure" [O.C. 6] — for from the soul come all of man's intellect, wisdom, and vitality — as it is written: *"and the breath of the Almighty gives them understanding"* [Iyov 32:8]. And this: "she is pure" — for in her root she is certainly pure and holy, and no grip of impurity has any hold over her whatsoever.

segments.he: וזהו שאמר השי"ת למשה ואמרת אל פרעה כה אמר ה' בני בכורי ישראל וכו' הנה אנכי הורג את בנך בכרך, כי הודיע לו תיכף מעלת קדושת ישראל שהם בחי' בכורים על שהם מקשרים עצמם אל השכל דקדושה שהוא בחי' ראשית בחי' בכורה וכן בחי' המלכות דקדושה נקראת בכורה כמ"ש אף אני בכור אתנהו עליון למלכי ארץ, ואח"כ כשבאו אל פרעה ואמרו לו וכו' התגרה בו כח הסט"א ביותר ואמר מי ה' אשר אשמע בקולו וכו' תכבד העבודה על האנשים וכו'. וזה כי ידבר אליכם פרעה וכו' וישלך אהרן את מטהו לפני פרעה וכו' ויהי לתנין, ובזה הראה לו כי עיקר כח מלכות פרעה שנקרא התנין הגדול וכו' הוא ג"כ רק ברצון והשגחת השי"ת בחי' מלכות שמים שהיא עיקר בחי' המלכות באמת שהיא בחי' מטה עוז שבט מושלים. ויקרא גם פרעה לחכמים וכו', כי רצה להתגבר כנגד התגלות הזאת ע"י החכמה דסט"א, ויבלע מטה אהרן את מטותם ובזה ראו בחוש שכח המלכות דקדושה גדול מאד ויכול לבלוע אותם כולם רק שהכל מתנהג ברצונו ית'.
segments.en:
סִימָן ק״ט

[§1]
And it is already somewhat explained: regarding the same species — it is nullified only through a majority — not counting things of importance and the like — as stated. And therefore: anything fixed [kavua] is considered as half and half. For since the prohibition and the permitted are each fixed in its own place — the concept of majority-nullification does not apply — unless one of them separated from its fixed place — then we say: "all that separates — separates from the majority." And therefore: all doubtful prohibitions are forbidden. For the essential deception of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara is through the aspect of doubts — for it is impossible for it to completely reverse a person's mind from one extreme to the other — and make something forbidden seem permitted — G-d forbid — only through the aspect of doubts — casting some aspect of doubt in the matter — and afterwards inciting one further — until it brings one to actual transgression — G-d forbid. And therefore our Sages were more stringent regarding a doubtful prohibition than a certain one at times — for the chatat [sin-offering] is one danka — and the asham talui [contingent guilt-offering] is two sela'im — (see Rabbeinu Yonah at the beginning of tractate Berachos). But even so: a doubt of a doubt [sfek sfeka] is permitted — for since there is yet another doubt inclining toward permitted — therefore according to some opinions it is like a majority — and even according to those who say it is somewhat less than a majority — even so we lean more toward permitted — for the hand of holiness is on top — the aspect of: "and great in kindness — He tilts toward kindness." And therefore: even in two pots — we say the prohibition fell into the prohibition — and the permitted into the permitted.

[§2]
And see Siman 111.

segments.he: ואעפ"כ ויחזק לב פרעה וכו' ויאמר ה' אל משה וכו' ואז היתה מכת דם שנהפכו כל המים אשר ביאור שזה היה עיקר כחם וממשלתם וכמובא גם בזוה"ק ונהפכו כולם לדם שזה סימן חורבן ומיתה, גם המים רמז לבחי' הדעת והשכל בחי' כמים לים מכסים ובזה הכניע לבחי' הדעת והשכל בחי' כמים לים מכסים ובזה הכניע בחי' הדעת והשכל של הסט"א. והדגה אשר ביאור, שהיא בחי' המלכות דסט"א, מתה וכו' ויעשו כן גם חרטומי מצרים, כי התגברו אעפ"כ בחכמתם הרעה ובכישופיהם ויחזק לב פרעה וכו' כאשר דיבר ה', כי כל זה היה ברצון הבורא ית':
segments.en: [§5] And this: "You created her, You formed her, You breathed her into me" — corresponding to Beriah, Yetzirah, Asiyah [the three lower worlds], as is cited — for she encompasses all of them together. And therefore, when a person uses the power of his soul and intellect only in holiness — that is, to bind himself to the intellect that exists in every thing, in order to draw close to Hashem, may He be blessed, through that very thing — through this he is able to ascend from level to level and from world to world, and to recognize and know and attain the intellect and divine life-force at each and every level, until he merits to recognize and attain Hashem, may He be blessed, as it were, beyond all worlds — as is understood in the discourse Vayiten Oz, Siman 78.

segments.he: ואח"כ הכה אותם השי"ת בצפרדעים שיצאו מן המים וציערו אותם וגם עשו היפך טבעם כי דרכם להיות במים והם באו בתנוריהם באש ובזה הראה להם כי הכל רק ברשותו ומלכותו ית': והיאור בעצמו שהוא עיקר כחם בתחלה הוכה הוא עצמו ונהפך לדם ואח"כ יצא ממנו בעצמו פורעניות להם.
segments.en:
סִימָן קי״ב וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת מַאֲכַלֵי עַכּוּ״ם

[§1]
The laws of foods of non-Jews. And therefore there are several things our Sages forbade on account of the risk of intermarriage — such as the bread of non-Jews — and foods cooked by non-Jews — and their beer and beverages — etc. For since the essential hold of the sitra achra is in the physicality of the person — in eating and drinking — one must distance greatly from their food and drink — for through this one can be caught in their traps and be enticed after them — until one comes to intermarriage with them — G-d forbid. And this is why our Sages used the language: on account of intermarriage. To allude: for through this one damages most greatly the holy union between the aspects of sun and moon of holiness — through which is made the letters of nachas — the aspect of: "the words of the wise are heard in gentleness" — as explained within. And this is also the letters of chasan [groom]. And this is the aspect of: *"and he is as a groom going out"* [Tehillim 19:6] — which is said of the sun.

[§2]
And when one damages this — through which one gives strength to the sitra achra — G-d forbid — this becomes the aspect of intermarriage of the sitra achra — G-d forbid. And therefore: if there was some force and assistance in it from a Jew — such as through stoking and a toothpick — the sitra achra can no longer overpower as much — and it is permitted.

segments.he: ואח"כ היתה מכת כנים כמ"ש ויך את עפר הארץ עפר רומז לבחי' מלכות כידוע ועפר מצרים רומז למלכות דסט"א והוכתה בכנים. ובמכה זו נכנעו בחי' החכמה שלהם וגם בחי' מלכות שלהם שזה בחי' ותהי הכנם באדם ובבהמה שהם בחי' חכמה ומלכות כידוע ואז ויעשו כן החרטומים בלטיהם וכו' ולא יכלו וכו' ואז הודו החרטומים ואמרו אצבע אלהים היא: ואח"כ היה מכת ערוב שהם חיות רעות וחיה היא בחי' חכמה ויש חיה שהיא בחי' מלכות כידוע ועיקר ההיזק שלהם היה כפי המובן ביותר בבני אדם כמ"ש בך ובעבדיך ובעמך וכו' ובני אדם הם בעלי שכל והיו ניזוקים ע"י חיות רעות שהם בחי' חכמות רעות גם היצה"ר נקרא חיה רעה כמ"ש חיה רעה אכלתהו ודרז"ל על אשת פוטיפר.
segments.en:
[§3]
And therefore: milk milked by a non-Jew without a Jew watching is forbidden — lest he mixed impure milk into it. And likewise: cheese of non-Jews is forbidden — since they curdle it with the rennet of neveilah — etc. For the general rule: one must guard oneself from all their foods — for most of the time there is in them the hold of the sitra achra — as stated.

segments.he: וזה והפלתי ביום ההוא את ארץ גושן וכו' למען תדע כי אני ה' בקרב הארץ, כי בתחלה במכות דם וצפרדע אמר לו בעבור תדע וכו' וכן למען תדע כי אין כה' אלהינו שזה בחי' הידיעה מאלהותו ית' שהוא עיקר בחי' הידיעה מאלהותו ית' שהוא עיקר בחי' השכל דקדושה בכלל ועכשיו ביאר לו בפרטיות ההבדל והפדות שיהיה בין מצרים ובין ישראל מחמת שהם מקושרים בבחי' השכל דקדושה בפרטיות וע"כ אמר לו למען תדע כי אני ה' בקרב הארץ, כי בכל דברים הארציים יש ג"כ חיות אלהות ושכל דקדושה והשגחה פרטיות וזה תראה בחוש ממה שבכל ארץ מצרים תשחת הארץ מפני הערוב ובארץ גושן לא היה הערוב:
segments.en: And this is what they said: pure milk curdles and stands firm — and impure milk does not curdle and stand firm. For the aspect of holiness is in the aspect of unity and connection — and in it there is the aspect of clarifying food from food — or from dross — like the clarification of cheese and butter from the whey of the milk.

segments.he: ואח"כ היתה מכת דבר רק בבהמות מצרים ולא בשל ישראל ובהמה הוא כנגד בחי' מלכות כידוע:
segments.en: [§6] And if he does not merit this in this world, he will merit it at least in the World to Come, after the resurrection. And this: "And You guard her within me, and You are destined to take her from me and to return her to me in the time to come." And this: "All the time that the soul is within me and bound to my body in this world, I give thanks before You" — "Master of all deeds" — and [Master] of all souls, which are the aspect of the sechel [intellects], and He includes and unifies and connects them all and sustains them all — and He is the Master of all of them. And they were all created and formed and made only in order to recognize Him, may He be blessed, through them.

segments.he: ואח"כ היתה מכת שחין באדם ובבהמה שהם כנגד שני הבחינות הנ"ל. וזהו שארז"ל שחין מצרים לח מבחוץ ויבש מבפנים שזה ג"כ כנגד שני בחינות הנ"ל. כי טבע הלבנה היא לחות וטבע החמה יבשות כידוע וע"כ נאמר גם אז ולא יכלו החרטומים לעמוד לפני משה מפני השחין:
segments.en: But the aspect of impurity is in the aspect of separation — the aspect of: "then all evildoers shall be scattered" — and everything is mixed together with the dross — since all of it is the aspect of complete dross — the aspect of: "all their tables are full of vomit and excrement — tell it to go away."

segments.he: ואח"כ היה מכת ברד והיתה רק בשדה שהוא בחי' חיצוניות בחי' מלכות רק שם היתה כוללת הכל אדם ובהמה ועשב בחי' מדבר חי צומח ששרשם אש רוח מים כידוע. והברד עצמו היה כלול מאש ומים שהם כנגד שני בחי' הנ"ל ונתייחדו ביחד והאש ירדה למטה לארץ היפוך טבעה וכל זאת להפרע מן המצרים ולהודיע כי אין כה' אלהינו בכל הארץ כי היכולת הוא רק בידו והכל נעשה רק ברצונו והשגחתו ית':
segments.en: [§7] And this: "Blessed [is He] Who restores souls to lifeless bodies." For this is a great wonder: that specifically through sleep — which is the aspect of the sitra d'mosa — specifically through this, the power and vitality of the soul in the mochin is strengthened and renewed, in the aspect of *"they are new every morning"* [Eichah 3:23] — as is known. And in this we see that *"the whole earth is full of His glory"* [Yeshayahu 6:3] — for even in the aspect of the sitra d'mosa itself, there is divine life-force and holy intellect, as it were.

segments.he: ואח"כ היה מכת הארבה.
segments.en: [§8] And therefore our Sages taught that from this we learn to believe in the resurrection of the dead — for even physical death itself is similarly only in this aspect, in order to renew through it specifically the light of the intellect and the soul, so that we may then recognize Hashem, may He be blessed, in a wondrous attainment, as is His will. And this is the aspect of *"and He preserves His faithfulness to those who sleep in the dust"* [Tehillim 146:6]. And from this is also derived a great strengthening for those who do teshuvah [repentance], for this is also the aspect of the resurrection of the dead.

segments.he: וארבה גימטריא ד' פעמים ב"ן ג"כ נגד בחי' מלכות והיתה כוללת בשדה ובבתים. כי המלכות כשעולה למקומה היא בבחי' בית כידוע ובאה ע"י הרוח ושלטה רק בדבר הצומח:
segments.en:
סִימָן קט״ז

[§1]
And therefore one must guard against eating anything with a concern of danger. For eating and the like must be from the side of holy wisdom — the aspect of life — and not from something with a concern of danger — the aspect of Esav — who said: "behold I am going to die" [Bereishis 25:32] — for he was always in a place of danger from wild animals — etc. — as the commentators explained. And therefore: it is also forbidden to eat something repulsive — etc. — for it is from the aspect of the hold of the sitra achra — which is disgusting and repulsive — as stated — the opposite of holy — which is in the aspect of grace and importance — as explained within.

segments.he: ואח"כ היה מכת חושך שהיא היפוך החכמה דקדושה שהיא עיקר האור וע"כ באמת ולכל בני ישראל היה אור במושבותם. והנה בהתראת מכת הארבה הסכים פרעה שיצאו הגברים שהם בעלי דעה שלימה אבל לא הנשים והטף שהם בחי' הקטנים במדריגה וכאן הסכים גם על הטף אבל לא על הצאן והבקר שהם מבחי' מלכות לבד כי רצה לינק מבחינה זאת עכ"פ. ואח"כ ויאמר ה' אל משה עוד נגע אחד וכו' ואז נאמר ויתן ה' את חן העם בעיני מצרים בבחי' חן הנ"ל:
segments.en: [§9] And in its plain sense, there is also a great ethical teaching alluded to in these very words for our purposes: for do we not see that when a person sleeps and the light of his intellect and soul withdraws, he is considered like a lifeless body? From this we see and understand that the essence of a person is his intellect — and therefore one must bind himself and look only at the intellect that exists in every thing, as stated above. And also — from the fact that the light of the intellect and soul is renewed specifically through sleep, by entering during sleep into the aspect of Malchus, which is the aspect of emunah [faith] — from this we see that the primary reception of the light of the intellect and its attainment is through Malchus — the aspect of נ [nun] — as stated above.

segments.he: ואח"כ היתה מכת בכורות נגד בחי' החכמה והמלכות שהם בחי' בכורה כנ"ל, כי החכמה היא בחי' ראשית ממעלה למטה ומלכות היא ראשית ממטה למעלה בחי' ראשית חכמה יראת ה' כידוע.
segments.en:
סִימָן קי״ז

[§1]
And therefore: it is forbidden to engage in commerce in things forbidden for eating — unless they came to one automatically — etc. — for the matter of trade — in all buying and selling — is through the aspect of intellect and wisdom. And therefore: the sale of a deaf-mute or a minor is nothing.

[§2]
And our Sages taught: "one who wishes to grow wise should engage in laws of monetary matters." And therefore: it is forbidden to trade and use one's intellect and wisdom in this matter — in forbidden things — which are from the aspect of the sitra achra — unless they came to one automatically within one's home — within permitted things. Such as in hunting — where impure things came to one alongside. But one's initial thought was not specifically for this. And likewise: if a neveilah or treifah happened to be found in one's home — one is permitted to sell it — for all of this was done without preparing one's mind for it. And likewise: collecting impure things as a debt from a non-Jew — is also out of necessity — for it is like saving from their hands — and it is considered as if it came to one automatically.

segments.he: וע"כ היתה מכת בכורות מבכור אדם ועד בכור בהמה והיתה בליל ט"ו בניסן במילוי הלבנה ומובא בזוה"ק נהיר הוה האי ליליא כיומא דתקופת תמוז כי נמשך אז בחי' והיה אור הלבנה כאור החמה, וזה ולכל בני ישראל לא יחרץ כלב (שהוא בחי' הסט"א והוא פיקח שבחיות כשארז"ל) לשונו למאיש ועד בהמה כי זכו לבחי' אדם ובהמה דקדושה ולא היה בהם שליטה לסטרא דמותא כלל.
segments.en: See the discourse Meketz Zikaron, Siman 54, where it is explained that Tzitzis and Tefillin [phylacteries] correspond to the tzimtzum [contraction / vessel] and the mochin [higher consciousness], and therefore Tzitzis precedes Tefillin — in the aspect of *"His left hand beneath my head, and then His right hand embraces me"* [Shir HaShirim 2:6] — see there. And similarly for our purposes: Tzitzis and Tefillin are the aspect of the נ [nun] and the ח [ches].

segments.he: ואז נצטוו על קידוש החדש כנ"ל, ועל לקיחת הקרבן פסח מבעשור ושחיטתו בי"ד בין הערבים, עיין זוה"ק בא דף מ"א אמור דף צ"ה ומכוון לענינינו, ועיין עוד שם פרשה בא דף ל"ח על דא כתיב מי לא יראך מלך וכו'. כי בכל חכמי הגוים ובכל מלכותם מאין כמוך, מכוון ג"כ לענינינו, ועיין שם בדף מ' מענין השבתת שאור וחמץ ואכילת מצה וכן בדף קפ"ב ובחלק ג' דף רנ"א ובדף רפ"ב ע"ב וכן בתיקונים בכמה מקומות ומכוון לענינינו, וזה שמסיים בסוף פרשת ויהי בחצי הלילה וכו' וה' נתן את חן העם וכו' כי זה כלל הבנין להעלות החן דקדושה של ישראל כנ"ל:
segments.en:
סִימָן קי״ח וְכוּ׳

[§1]
And therefore: if one deposits or sends with a non-Jew — or a suspect — something with a biblical concern of prohibition — lest he exchange it — one needs a seal within a seal — corresponding to the aspect of these rectifications. For the mochin and wisdom are the aspect of a seal — the aspect of tefillin — the aspect of mochin — which are in the aspect of a seal — as is known. And likewise: Malchus is the aspect of a seal — as our Sages taught [Bereishis Rabbah, Parshas Vayeshev]: "your seal and your cord — your seal is Malchus" — etc. — see there.

segments.he: וזה ג"כ בחי' דם פסח ודם מילה כמובן בזוה"ק ובכתבים, וזהו שארז"ל שהגאולה היתה בזכות יעקב ויוסף שנאמר גאלת בזרוע עמך בני יעקב ויוסף סלה כי הם זכו להמשיך התיקונים הנ"ל בשלימות כמבפ"נ:
segments.en: [§1] For Tzitzis are the aspect of tzimtzum [contraction] — which is the aspect of Malchus [Kingship] — the aspect of נ [nun] — as is known [see Likutay Halachos, Laws of Deposits]. And Tefillin are the aspect of the ח [ches] — the aspect of holy Chochmah [Wisdom] and mochin. And therefore the Tzitzis are on the garments and vestments, which are the aspect of Malchus. And this is the aspect of *"He wraps Himself in light like a garment"* [Tehillim 104:2] — that He wraps the Light and clothes it in vestments — the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of נ [nun] — so that we can attain it. And this is also the aspect of the wings of the Tzitzis — in the aspect of *"and the children of men take shelter in the shadow of Your wings"* [Tehillim 36:8] — for the essence of life and vitality, which is through wisdom and intellect, cannot be received or attained except through the aspect of the shadow made by the wings and vestments — the aspect of Malchus. And this: *"for with You is the source of life"* [Tehillim 36:10].

segments.he: ונחזור לענינינו. וע"כ אין יוצאין ידי חובת מצה אלא מחמשת המינין שהם חטה ושעורה וכו' כי הם מבחי' הקדושה כמבואר בזוהר ח"ב דף ק"כ שהם נמשלים לישראל, ובח"ג דף רמ"ד מבואר שאין ממונה עליהם אלא הקב"ה בעצמו וכן בזוהר חדש, וע"כ המצה שרומז לבחי' היצ"ט מלכות דקדושה צריך להיות מהם דייקא, גם שאר מנים אינם באים לידי חימוץ כי זה לעומת זה כי מחמת שיש בהם קדושה יתירה בשרשם ע"כ מתגברת הסט"א ביותר לינק מהם וכשארז"ל שהיצר הרע אינו מתגרה אלא בישראל וביותר בגדולי ישראל.
segments.en:
סִימָן קיט וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת גִּיטִּין

[§1]
The laws of gittin [divorce]. It is written: *"if a man takes a woman"* [Devarim 24:1] — etc. — "and it shall be if she finds no favor in his eyes" — etc. — "and he shall write her a bill of severance" — etc. For the holy union — when it is complete — is in the aspect of chen — as stated. But when the union does not go well — and through this she finds no favor in his eyes — then he must write her a sefer [document] specifically. For sefer alludes to the aspect of Chochmah — as cited in the interpretation of Sefer Yetzirah on the matters of: sefer [book], sofer [scribe], and sippur [narrative] — and as cited in the holy Zohar. And likewise: holy Torah is called sefer. And likewise: the aspect of Malchus is called sefer — as is known. Therefore one must write her a bill of severance — and place it in her hand — and send her from his home. Meaning: just as the holy union was through these three aspects — through which Torah gives strength to holy Malchus — and through this Malchus — the aspect of nun — was connected and bound with the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of ches — and receives life-force from it — as stated — so now: the separation and divorce between them is also not in the aspect of separation of the sitra achra entirely — G-d forbid. Rather: this separation too is according to holy Torah — and according to the drawing of these rectifications — the aspects of Chochmah and Malchus.

[§2]
And through this she is permitted to another man — to unite with him in the aspect of holy union. And this is the aspect of: "and she shall depart from his home and go and become the wife of another man." For the essential departure from his home — according to the bill of severance he gives her — according to the law of his holy Torah — is only for the sake of holy union — to unite with another man in complete holiness as is fitting. Only: the essential revelation of the matter of severance between them is through the sefer — the aspect of Torah. And this is the aspect of: "the document severs her" — etc. And therefore the one divorcing must be of sound mind — at the time of writing the get and giving it.

[§3]
Since the root of the entire matter is from the aspect of Chochmah — as stated. And this is the aspect of the three expressions of divorce written in the get: shavaktin [I have released you] — piturin [dismissal] — tiruchin [sending away]. For since this very separation is according to holy Torah — sometimes: if the woman is wicked and dissolute — it is a commandment to divorce her. And if she is not dissolute — then the separation is so that there be afterwards through this a complete holy union. It emerges: through these divorces one is separating and sending away the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — who wanted to take hold in this union. For since lo misdar lehu — and she found no favor in his eyes — and there is a division of hearts and hatred between them — automatically there is more of a hold of the sitra achra there — since they are in the aspect of the sitra d'piruda — as stated. Therefore: if it is impossible to make peace between them — such that their union be in love and brotherhood and companionship as befitting a holy union — then on the contrary: in such a union there is hold of the sitra achra — to the point that children born from this union are sometimes called children of hatred — G-d forbid. Therefore: the divorce — through which they fully separate from each other — is in the aspect of driving away the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — so that they have no portion and hold in the union of Israel.

[§4]
And regarding the matter of divorce and separation — there are three aspects — one after the other. And all three are encompassed under the heading of severance. For sometimes when she does not find favor in his eyes — he abandons her and distances himself from her in his heart — and through this she too distances herself from him — and separation arises between them. And this is encompassed under: shavaktin — that he abandoned her. And sometimes she does not separate from him until he actually divorces her from his home with complete divorce. And this is encompassed under: tiruchin. And these three aspects exist also in the matter of subduing the yetzer hara — which is also the aspect of divorce — as cited in the kavanos on the verse: "when he changed his behaviour before Avimelech — and he drove him away — and he departed" [Tehillim 34:1]. For sometimes the yetzer hara separates from one only through abandoning and leaving it — and not listening to it — and through this it separates from one without any arguments or quarrels. And sometimes one must push it away with even more distancing — the aspect of piturin. And sometimes one must drive it away with even greater distancing — to the point of complete divorce — the aspect of tiruchin. And this too is the aspect of what Avraham our father said to Lot — who is the aspect of the yetzer hara — as cited in the holy Zohar: *"separate please from me"* [Bereishis 13:9] — etc. — "if to the right — I will go left — and if to the left — I will go right." Even if it tempts one sometimes — and dresses in the temptation of a mitzvah — the aspect of right — even so: one should not listen to it — since one has already understood its ultimate intention — and knows it is an enemy and foe — lurking against one — and rising against one — as is also understood in the holy Zohar on this matter.

segments.he: והמנהג ליקח לכתחילה חטים כי בם הקדושה נתגלה ביותר וע"כ הם בבחי' דעת ובבחי' כ"ב אותיות התורה וכ"ב אותיות שבמלכות פה כנ"ל, וגם כי בזה ממשיכין תיקון ביותר לאכילת עץ הדעת שארז"ל חטה היתה:
segments.en:
[§5]
And since holy Torah — and likewise our Sages — greatly dislike the matter of quarrel and separation between a person and one's fellow — and especially between husband and wife — they therefore hinted to us through this: that even if sometimes it is unavoidably necessary to separate from each other — even so it is better to minimize quarrel and division of hearts as much as possible. And therefore they arranged first the expression shavaktin — and then piturin — and then tiruchin — according to the gradations — one after the other — as stated. For at first one must think: perhaps one will only need to separate from her through the aspect of shavaktin alone. And if not — then necessity demands the aspect of piturin. And if not — then necessity demands the aspect of tiruchin. Only: since it is impossible to arrange the order of the gradations with a fixed rule — for sometimes necessity demands immediately at the very beginning to distance her with somewhat greater distancing — therefore they subsequently arranged the expression u'pirtas first. And sometimes one needs immediately even more distancing — therefore they subsequently arranged further the expression tiruchin first. And in this matter too they took care to arrange according to the gradations — first putting the expression shavaktin — then putting piturin — and finally putting tiruchin — all according to the above. And to clarify the matter a bit more: for sometimes — if he is divorcing her because she is a wicked and dissolute woman — it is a commandment to divorce her — then one must immediately distance her through the aspect of divorce and tiruchin — the aspect of: "drive out the scorner — and strife will depart" [Mishlei 22:10]. And sometimes — if he is divorcing her only because she found no favor in his eyes — then it is a commandment to minimize the quarrel and division of hearts as much as possible — through the aspects of shavaktin and piturin mentioned.

[§6]
But also in this there are aspects — such that sometimes one immediately needs the aspect of piturin — or even tiruchin. And all according to the matter — as long as all one's actions and all one's intention are for the sake of Heaven. And likewise in the matter of the divorce of subduing the yetzer hara — there are also these aspects. For our Sages taught: the yetzer hara — a child and a woman — push away with the left and draw close with the right. But if the yetzer hara tempts one to actual transgression — G-d forbid — then one must divorce it immediately and push it away with both hands — the aspect of: "Hashem rebukes you — O Satan" [Zechariah 3:2] — etc. But also in the matter of the inclination's temptation regarding what is permitted — there are various aspects. For sometimes even this inclination must be distanced immediately and without delay — since one sees and understands that its intention is for evil — G-d forbid — and one cannot elaborate on these matters — and it is self-evident. And therefore one must draw out the vavs of shavaktin — piturin — tiruchin — and also the vav of v'tarkas.

[§7]
For the vav is generally the vav of connection. And also it is elaborated in the holy Zohar that vav is the aspect of life. Therefore: even in these words — the essential words of severance and divorce — they allude that this is not a complete separation — the aspect of the sitra achra — the sitra d'piruda — the sitra d'mosa — G-d forbid. For death separates — etc. Rather: the essential purpose of this separation is for the sake of the complete union that will come through this afterwards — the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of life — the aspect of: "there is no get after death." And this is the aspect of the large vavs in the get — which allude to the aspect of connection and life and peace — as stated. And also: it is elaborated in the discourse Ashrei mentioned — that holy Torah is the aspect of vav. And through it all the drawing of these rectifications — which are hinted at in the holy divorce mentioned. And this: one must be careful about the leg of the Heh of l'mehaich [to walk] — that one distances it from its roof. And likewise in all the Hehs. For since the divorce is in the aspect of driving away the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — who wanted to take hold in this union — the aspect of: "rebuking the serpent of the reed" — for one rebukes the sitra achra — and makes from ches a Heh — as elaborated in the holy Zohar and in the discourse b'Chatzotzerot, Siman Heh. For corresponding to holy Chochmah — the aspect of ches — as stated — there is the aspect of the ches of the sitra achra — the aspect of the daughters of Ches — as is known. For there is the aspect of holy life-force — and corresponding to it — the aspect of the life-force of the sitra achra — which is worse than death — the aspect of: "one who wishes to die — shall live." And this is the aspect of the wicked woman — who is worse than death. Therefore one must divorce this aspect — and separate the attached — and make from ches a Heh. And this is why one must be precise about the Hehs of the get — especially that of l'mehaich — that it not appear as l'machach — the language of mockery and laughter — the aspect of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara — the aspect of: "laughter is foolishness" — and as it is written: "as laughter is to the fool — to do lewdness" [Mishlei 10:23]. The aspect of the life-force of the sitra achra — who make all their days as festivals — and spend their days in laughter and frivolity. And lives such as these are worse than death — for they are from the aspect of the wicked woman — the sitra achra — of whom it is said: "she laughs at them with wealth in this world — and afterwards kills them". (And see the discourse Tzivisa Tzedek, Siman 23.) And therefore one must be particularly precise about this Heh. And therefore the get concludes: "according to the law of Moshe and Israel."

[§8]
For the essential matter of this separation — which is to divorce the sitra achra and the yetzer hara literally — if she is a wicked and dissolute woman whom it is a commandment to divorce — and also if this is not the case — only that lo misdar lehu — and she found no favor in his eyes — and this itself is from the aspect of the hold of the yetzer hara and the sitra achra — who provoke between them — until they are compelled to come to complete divorce and separation — so that both may afterwards merit holy union through these divorces. But all of this happens only through the power of holy Torah — through which the yetzer hara is subdued — and strength given to holy Malchus — as stated. And this is something that commonly happens many times — that there are quarrels and strife between a couple — until they come to divorce. And afterwards they take each other back — and there is peace between them forever. And this is because the sitra achra has already been divorced from taking hold and provoking between them — through the get and the divorce that was between them. And therefore the get must be before fit witnesses — the aspect of: "the testimony of Hashem is faithful — it makes wise the simple" — as elaborated above. Not only that — the custom is that the get be before ten Jews — for: "when ten are present — the Shechinah rests there." And therefore the sitra achra — the sitra d'piruda — cannot suckle from this — since everything is done according to holy Torah — and for the sake of the peace of holy union — of which it is said: "if they merited — the Shechinah dwells among them."

[§9]
And therefore the writing and signing of the get must be for the sake of the man divorcing and for the sake of the woman being divorced — in order to separate them through this at their root — where is the root of his name and her name — the aspect of: "living soul — that is his name." And this itself is the aspect of the writing and signing — (as cited in the Tikkunim, Tikkun 18): "the writing hand — this is the written Torah" (whose root is in Chochmah) — "the signing hand — this is the Oral Torah" (the aspect of Malchus-of-mouth — and it is called the Oral Torah). And therefore the scribe must also say before him that he is writing for her sake — etc. — and likewise the witnesses. For thought and speech are also in the aspect of Chochmah and Malchus — as is known. And therefore one writes in the get twelve lines — corresponding to twelve months — twelve tribes — upon which holy Malchus stands — as elaborated in the holy Zohar and in his teachings. And therefore all the lines in the get must be equal. For this is the essential fullness — that all twelve tribes be encompassed in one unity — so that the kingdom of the sitra achra — the sitra d'piruda — have no power to dominate them — as our Sages taught about: "the joining of the idols — Efraim — let it be" [Hoshea 4:17]. And then the holiness of the drawing of holy Malchus — the Heavenly Kingdom — shines in its fullness over them. The aspect of what the tribes said: "Hear O Israel" — etc. — "Hashem is One" — as our Sages taught. And this: *"and in Yeshurun there was a King — when the heads of the people were gathered — together the tribes of Israel"* [Devarim 33:5] — as stated.

segments.he: וע"כ צריכין לשמור החטים משעת קצירה ולפחות משעת טחינה, כי קמח רומז ביותר לבחי' מלכות כידוע וצריכה שמירה שלא יבואו עליה בחי' המים הזדונים של היצה"ר ויחמיצוה כי אית מיא ואית מיא כידוע, ועיקר השימור הוא למצת מצוה שרומזת לבחי' הנ"ל וצריכה שמירה יתירה, גם כי היא ממדת שמור, אכן ישראל קדושים ומשמרין כל המצות של פסח משעת טחינה עכ"פ ומכש"כ משעת לישה עד אחר האפיה:
segments.en: [§2] And this: the word Tzitzis is an expression of gazing — as it is written: *"and you shall see it"* [Bamidbar 15:39] — for through this one merits to gaze upon the light of the intellect and the Divinity that exists in every thing — which is the aspect of the totality of Torah and mitzvos, in the aspect of what our Sages taught: "Know Him in all your ways" [Mishlei 3:6] — that is the great principle in Torah — and in the aspect of what is cited in the Shulchan Aruch, Siman 1: "I have placed Hashem before me always" [Tehillim 16:8] — that is the great principle in Torah.

segments.he: וע"כ אין אדם יוצא חובתו בפסח בפת של סובין או מורסן שאינו קרוי לחם שהוא בחי' מלכות דקדושה: וע"כ אין לשין המצות אלא בצוננין ולא בפושרין שלא יתאחז בהם החמימות דסט"א ותחמיץ העיסה:
segments.en:
סִימָן ק״כ

[§1]
And therefore: eating vessels of non-Jews made of metal require immersion. For the body of the food and the meal — through which is man's life-force — is in the aspect of wisdom. And the vessel in which one eats is in the aspect of Malchus. And therefore: eating vessels — even new ones — since they were in the possession of non-Jews and were prepared for the meals of non-Jews — the spirit of impurity — from the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — rests upon them. And the root of this is from the aspect of sospisa d'dahava [the dross of gold] — the aspect of the extension of gevuros — which are the aspect of fire — the aspect of metal vessels that are made through being melted in fire. And therefore: when one brings them into the possession of Israel — they require immersion in water — whose root is from the aspect of chasadim — the aspect of wisdom — the aspect of Torah. And through all of this the gevuros are sweetened at their root — and the aspect of the spirit of folly — spirit of impurity — is nullified — and the vessel rises from impurity to purity.

[§2]
And therefore: if one borrowed or rented a vessel from a non-Jew — immersion is not required. For it is still under the owner's authority — and also: it does not overpower as much — since it has not yet left the possession of the non-Jew — and is destined to return there. But when it leaves the possession of the non-Jew to the possession of Israel — then it overpowers more to suckle from the holiness — and therefore immersion is required.

[§3]
And therefore: old vessels of non-Jews — immersion is not sufficient — but as was their use — so must they be kashered. In the aspect of: *"all that comes into fire — pass it through fire"* [Bamidbar 31:23]. For since the vessel absorbed from the forbidden food itself — which is from the aspect of the sitra achra — therefore: if it absorbed through fire — it specifically requires libun [burning out] through fire. And if it absorbed through boiling water — it requires hag'alah [boiling out]. And if it absorbed while cold — washing and rinsing suffices. And this has been somewhat explained in Orach Chaim. And the matter of nosen ta'am lifgam [gives a spoiled taste] — and a vessel that is not a ben yomo — is somewhat explained above.

segments.he: וע"כ אין לשין אלא במים שלנו, ויש בזה כמה שיטות כמבואר בשו"ע סי' תנ"ה והכל סובב על דרך זה כי חוששין שמא שלט בהם חמימות החמה שמהלכת ביום סמוך למעיינות בימי החורף ע"כ צריכין שיצטננו ע"י מידת לילה שהיא בחי' קרירות והעיקר מחצות הלילה עד עמוד השחר, וי"א שהטעם מחמת שבלילה החמה מהלכת תחת הקרקע ומחממתן לפיכך צריכין שיעמדו במחובר לקרקע כל היום שאז הקרקע שהיא ג"כ מבחי' מדה זו מצננתן, ועיין בשו"ע ותבין ביותר:
segments.en: [§3] And this: "And you shall remember all the commandments of Hashem" — etc. — for all the mitzvos are aspects of contractions [tzimtzumim] through which one attains the perception of His G-dliness, may He be blessed [see the discourse Mishra, Siman 30]. And this: "and you shall not stray after your heart and after your eyes" — through which the yetzer hara incites, in the aspect of the klipa of Esav and Yishmael, the kingdoms of the sitra achra. For by remembering all of Hashem's commandments — which are the aspect of the totality of the holy Torah — one thereby subdues the yetzer hara and the kingdoms of the sitra achra. And then one merits to study and fulfil the Torah at a far greater level, until one attains a true attainment of the light of the holy wisdom and intellect — which are the aspect of Kodesh [sanctity], as is known.

segments.he: וע"כ אין לשין לפסח עיסה גדולה משיעור חלה דהיינו עשירית האיפה שהיא בחי' מלכות לפי שא"א לעסוק בה בשעת הלישה היטב להצילה מידי חימוץ:
segments.en: סִימָן קכ״ג וְכוּ׳

segments.he: וע"כ נוהגין ללוש מצת מצוה בערב פסח אחר שש שעות, כי זה עיקר השלימות בבחי' סור מרע ועשה טוב לבער החמץ תחלה בזמנו וכשמגיע זמן איסור החמץ מן התורה שאז עיקר זמן חורבן והכנעת הסט"א אז עיקר הזמן לעסוק בבנין המלכות דקדושה שהיא בחי' מצת מצוה:
segments.en:
[§1]
And therefore: the prohibition of drinking the wine of non-Jews is very severe — and even through their mere touch it becomes forbidden. For since in holiness its root is very lofty — and encompasses all the aspects of these rectifications. For it is from the aspect of wisdom and mochin — the aspect of: "wine and fragrance open the mind" — and the aspect of Torah — and the aspect of Malchus — the aspect of: "and the wine of the kingdom was abundant" [Esther 1:7] — etc. — as understood in the discourse Tehillah L'Dovid, Siman 12 — and likewise in the holy Zohar. And this is the aspect of: "he who merits — becomes a head." And therefore one must truly be very careful in its drinking — not to exceed the measure — G-d forbid — for intoxicating wine is the aspect of the very opposite of all the above. And therefore: it becomes forbidden through the touch of a non-Jew — and damages the soul of the Jew who drinks it — and the yetzer hara overpowers him even more — until one can come through this to all evil — G-d forbid. And this is the aspect of: "and concerning their wine — on account of their daughters." And see in the book Yayin HaMeshomar [The Preserved Wine] — which elaborated greatly on the severity of the prohibition — and you will understand from there for our subject. And according to the above you will understand how to explain many verses and teachings of our Sages that speak of wine in praise — or the opposite — and all of it is understood according to the above.

segments.he: וע"כ אין לשין במקום השמש ולא סמוך לחום התנור בכדי שלא ישלוט בה החמימות דסט"א: וע"כ לא יניחו העיסה בלי עסק אפילו רגע אחת, כי צריך לידע שהשונא עומד ואורב עליו מכל צד ובכל רגע ועיקר שליטתו בעת שהאדם פנוי ובטל מעסק תורה או מצוה, וזה שאמרו כל זמן שמתעסקין בו אפילו כל היום אינו מחמיץ, כי על ידי העסק נותנין כח במלכות דקדושה שהיא בחי' העיסה שלא יוכל החימוץ לשלוט ולהתאחז בה, ואם הניחו בלא עסק שיעור מיל שהוא בחי' תחום שבת תחום וגבול הקדושה שהיא בחי' מלכות (עיין מאורי אור) הוי חמץ, וגם שיעור מיל הוי ח"י מינוטין ובזה נפגם בחי' החיות דקדושה והתגבר החמץ סיטרא דמותא ח"ו (ויש אומרים שמיל הוא שיעור שני חומשי שעה וכו' עיין שו"ע), ואחר שנתעסקו בבצק ונתחמם בידים אם יניחוהו בלא עסק מיד יחמיץ כי אז מתגבר הסט"א ביותר בכדי לקבל יניקה מהקדושה כידוע ע"כ צריכין ליזהר אז בשמירה יתירה ביותר:
segments.en: [§4] And this is the doubling in the verse: "so that you shall remember" — etc. — "and you shall be holy to your G-d — holy" — specifically holy. And this: "I am Hashem your G-d Who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be a G-d unto you" — for on this very condition He took them out of there: that they should sanctify themselves with His sanctity, and bind themselves only to the G-dliness in every thing, in order to draw close to Him in truth. And this: "I am Hashem your G-d" — Emes v'Yatziv [True and Firm] in the morning — for then one merits to receive the light of the intellect and mochin, which are the essence of the light of day — and Emes v'Emunah [True and Faith] in the evening — for even in the time of the withdrawal of the light of the intellect and the mochin, one must still bind oneself to the holy intellect — which is the aspect of truth — through the holy attribute of faith, which is the attribute of night — the aspect of נ [nun] mentioned above.

segments.he: וע"כ אין מתעסקין במצת מצוה ע"י עכו"ם שהוא מצד הסט"א ואפילו ע"י ישראל שהוא אינו בר דעת ואין לו חלק בשכל דקדושה כגון חרש שוטה וקטן אסור ג"כ. וע"כ גדולי ישראל היו מתעסקין בעצמן במצת מצוה בכל כחם כי כל מה שמתעסק בה בר דעת גדול ביותר ובכל כחו על ידי זה משפיע בה כח גדול ביותר וממקום גבוה ועליון ביותר, ועל כל פנים יהיו עומדין בעצמן בשעת עשייתן ומזרזין את העוסקין בהם כי על ידי שנעשה הכל בהשגחתו נמשך עליה גם כן הארה יתירה ביותר וגם כפשוטו כי כל מה שדעתם גדולה ביותר ממילא נזהרין בשמירת המצת מצוה בזהירות יתירה ביותר:
segments.en:
סִימָן קל״ה — קְרִיאַת הַתּוֹרָה

 

 
 [§1]
 And therefore one reads in the Torah during prayer — 
 for the essential acceptance of prayer is through the Torah, 
 through which one gives strength to the holy Malchus — 
 the aspect of the yetzer tov — 
 to overpower the kingdom of the sitra achra — 
 the aspect of the yetzer hara — the aspect of Esav. 
 And therefore our Sages taught: 
 "At the time when the voice is the voice of Yaakov" — 
 when they engage in Torah — 
 "the hands are not the hands of Esav." 
 And our Sages expounded [Bava Kamma 82a]: 
 *"and they walked three days in the wilderness and found no water"* [Shemos 15:22] — 
 that they walked three days without Torah, and they arose and rebelled 
 [because the yetzer hara overpowered them] — 
 therefore the prophets and elders instituted 
 that they should read [the Torah] on Shabbos, Monday, and Thursday — etc. — 
 for when they engage in Torah, their yetzer is given into their hands — as our Sages taught.
 

 
 [§2]
 And therefore the primary reading of the Torah in its completeness is on Shabbos — 
 for "the Torah emanates from supernal Wisdom" [Zohar] — 
 and on Shabbos the light of Chochmah shines with a wondrous illumination, 
 and therefore it is called Kodesh [holy] — as is known — 
 and likewise Malchus ascends then with wondrous ascents — as is known. 
 And therefore one also reads the Torah on Shabbos at Minchah — 
 to draw, through the holiness of Shabbos, the power of Torah reading 
 for the coming week as well. 
 And one also reads the Torah on Monday and Thursday — 
 in order to subdue the kingdom of the sitra achra and the yetzer hara 
 also on the weekdays — 
 and all of this is only through the power of holy Torah study. 
 And through this all prayers are accepted — 
 and therefore on Monday and Thursday one adds more prayers and supplications, 
 and recites V'Hu Rachum [He is compassionate].
 

 
 [§3]
 And therefore every Friday — 
 in which there is holiness and Torah in abundance — 
 and Kodesh is the aspect of Chochmah — as stated — 
 one multiplies the number of those called up [kruy'im] as our Sages taught. 
 And they further said: 
 those three, five, and seven [called up] — corresponding to what? 
 Corresponding to those who see the face of the King — etc. — 
 for through Torah reading one gives strength to the aspect of holy Malchus — as stated — 
 and Malchus is the aspect of Dalet — as stated — 
 and therefore one reads in the Torah four times each week. 
 And therefore one does not read fewer than ten verses — 
 and our Sages said these correspond to the ten idlers of the synagogue 
 who are permanently stationed there to pray at the proper time each day with a congregation.
 

 
 [§4]
 And this is the aspect of prayer. 
 And the synagogue too is the aspect of Malchus — as is known. 
 And one [opinion] said: 
 [the ten verses] correspond to the Ten Commandments, which are the totality of the Torah. 
 And one said: corresponding to the Ten Utterances [Asarah Ma'amaros] — 
 which are the life-force of every thing — 
 the aspect of wisdom and intellect clothed in every thing — 
 in the aspect of *"all of them You made with wisdom"* [Tehillim 104:24]. 
 Except for the portion of Amalek — 
 which is the totality of the kingdoms of the sitra achra — 
 and in it is written: *"there is war for Hashem against Amalek from generation to generation"* [Shemos 17:16] — 
 for his [heavenly] prince is himself the yetzer hara — 
 and because of the power of free choice it is presently impossible to nullify him completely — 
 therefore his portion is also deficient, 
 containing only nine verses — as our Sages taught.

segments.he: סימן תס"ב וכו'

וע"כ מי פירות בלא מים מדינא אין מחמיצין כלל. שדייקא המים שרומזין לבחינות גבוהות כידוע והם בחי' מימי הדעת מימי החסד מימי התורה מימי התשובה והתפלה כ"ש שפכי כמים לבך וארז"ל מים קדמו לעולם ע"כ לעומת זה גם הסט"א שהם בחי' המים הזדונים (שבהם עיקר אחיזת עשו וישמעאל המלכיות דסט"א כמובן בזוה"ק בשלח ס"ד ע"ב) כרוכים אחריהם ומחמיצים את העיסה. מה שאין כן מי פירות אין מחמיצין. אבל אם יש בהם איזה מים אזי ממהרין להחמיץ. כי אז הסט"א כרוכה אחר המים ביותר מאחר שהם מעורבים עם מי פירות שיש בהם מתענוגות בני אדם.
segments.en: [§5] A garment worn at night is exempt from Tzitzis — for although Tzitzis are the aspect of tzimtzum and the nun, as stated, nonetheless since it is specifically through this that one merits to receive the light of the intellect — as is explained within — which means that the ches and the nun become joined and the moonlight becomes as the light of the sun — it is thereby self-understood that within them shines the light of the intellect and wisdom. This is the aspect of what is explained in the kavanos: that the 32 threads of the Tzitzis correspond to the 32 paths of Wisdom. And this is what our Sages taught: "Whoever fulfils the mitzvah of Tzitzis is as if he received the face of the Shechinah" — meaning he merits to attain the light of the intellect and G-dliness in truth. And therefore a garment designated only for nighttime, worn only at night, is universally exempt from Tzitzis — since that is the time of withdrawal of the mochin and intellect, and one receives the holy vitality only through the aspect of faith.

segments.he: גם אין יוצאין עם מצה כזו חובת מצה כי אין זה לחם עוני שהוא בחי' המלכות דקדושה בחי' מסכן רק הוא מצה עשירה (אלא אם כן המי פירות בטלין בסמ"ך ואין מרגישין טעמם עיין בשו"ע) ובמדינות אלו נוהגין שלא ללוש אפילו במי פירות לבד אם לא בשעת הדחק לצורך חולה וזקן וכו' כמבואר בשו"ע:
segments.en:
סִימָן קל״ט וְכוּ׳ — הִלְכוֹת עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה

[§1]
The laws of idolatry. For the essential root of all idolatry is from the yetzer hara — which is itself the aspect of idolatry — as it is written: "there shall not be in you a strange god" [Tehillim 81:10] — and our Sages taught accordingly. And our Sages taught: "such is its way — today it says to him: do such — etc. — and tomorrow it says: go worship idolatry." And this is the essential impurity — the very opposite of holiness. For this is the essential sitra achra — and it is the aspect of vomit and excrement — for there is no aspect at all of the illumination of holy intellect in it — the aspect of: "My glory I shall not give to another" [Yeshayahu 42:8] — as explained elsewhere. And therefore they are called elilim [nothings] — for they are the aspect of absolute nothing — as if they never existed — the opposite of holy Chochmah — the aspect of yesh me'ayin [something from nothing] — as is known. And therefore idolatry is forbidden for any benefit — for all of a person's pleasure and his spirit's satisfaction is an aspect of a spark from the aspects of the portions of his life-force. But idolatry — which is the essential sitra d'mosa — it is forbidden for Israel to receive from it any benefit or any aspect of life-force whatsoever — for such a life-force is more bitter than death — G-d forbid.

[§2]
And this is the aspect of: it is forbidden for benefit — along with its accessories and its adornments and its offerings. Its accessories correspond to the aspect of the kingdom of the sitra achra — for through serving before it — the aspect of a servant serving his master — one thereby shows that one is accepting the yoke of its kingdom. Its adornments correspond to the aspect of the intellect of the sitra achra — for the essential beauty and splendor at its root is from the aspect of Chochmah — the aspect of light — the aspect of: "a man's wisdom illuminates his face."

segments.he: סימן תס"ח וכו'
וזה בחי' איסור מלאכה מערב פסח אחר חצות. כי נמשך אז בחי' הארת קדושת יום טוב שהוא בחי' המשכת התיקונים הנ"ל:
segments.en:
[§3]
And its offerings correspond to the aspect of the union of sun and moon of the sitra achra together — G-d forbid — and as they say: k'din metashteshei alma [it causes confusion in the world] — G-d forbid. For the sitra achra is like a monkey before a man.
